sentences.text:
This is an application under Order XI Rule 1 of the CPC on behalf of the Plaintiff for placing on record the FSL Report which is a part of the proceedings in FIR No.222/2018 dated 30.03.2018 registered at Police Station Sadar Palwal, Haryana for offences under Section 420, 467, 468, 471,
120B & 201 IPC.
2.

The instant suit has been filed for declaration in favour of the Plaintiff and against the Defendant/Bank declaring that the transactions enumerated in the plaint are void and not binding upon the Plaintiff company for having been conducted without any authority, sanction and consent of the Plaintiff This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 10/11/2025 at 20:56:37 and on the basis of fraud and gross negligence perpetrated by the Defendant.

3. It is the case of the Plaintiff that certain fraudulent transactions have been done wherein amounts of the Plaintiff to the tune of Rs.5,55,46,177/- have been defalcated from the accounts of the Plaintiff.

sentences.text:
It is stated that though in the FIR, the accused is not the Bank but at least this lease document would be necessary for adjudication of the case in the nature of transactions.
5. Learned Counsel for the Defendant vehemently opposes the application by contending inter alia as under:-
i.
That the document was available 17.08.2021 and the present application has been filed in the year 2025 and there is no reason as to why this document has been filed after four years.
ii. That the accused is neither the Bank nor the employees of the Bank and therefore this document has not relevance.
iii. That the issues have already been framed and this application is to delay the trial.
6. The Plaintiff's evidence has been filed and no substantial progress in the trial has been made.

7. Since the nature of the suit is that the transaction was fraudulent and monies have been taken away, this Court is of the opinion that it would be in the interest of justice that this document is permitted to be placed on record by the Plaintiff.

8. However, it is needless to mention that since this document has been permitted to be taken on record by this Court, the same does not mean that the correctness of the documents has been ascertained.
The document has to pass the necessary test of admission/denial of documents with proof

9. With these observations, the application is allowed.

10. List before the learned Joint Registrar on 16.12.2025 for admission/denial of documents.
11.
List on 21.01.2026 for framing of additional issues, if any.

1. This is an application under Order VII Rule 11 of the CPC on behalf of the Defendant for rejection of the plaint on the ground that the suit has been filed without any authority and has not been instituted by a competent person.
2. Issue notice.
3. Learned Counsel for the Plaintiff, accepts notice.
He seeks some time to file a reply.
4. Let reply be filed within a week from today.
Response thereto, if any, be filed within a week thereafter.
